summary: Implementation plan for creating a comprehensive public repository documentation suite for DECK / divider. Covers a strict proprietary commercial source-available LICENSE with rigorous scrutinizing clauses, an industry-standard README.md with architecture and feature overviews, an in-depth ARCHITECTURE.md system breakdown, SECURITY.md vulnerability policy aligned with RFC 9116, CONTRIBUTING.md governance restricting external PRs while welcoming bug reports, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md community standards, and DEVELOPMENT.md developer manual.
